method: Lossless shared answers, keyed by SHA-256 of the original JSON payload. Each stage references answerId. All settings, high-depth scores, excluded keys, input positions, hashes, native call counts and raw timings retained. Diagnostic cases, not random sampling, a phone benchmark, or an independent strength test.

runs.method: Alternating paired fresh workers. Identical bg6 SIMD native assets. Hint then two legal moves outside that hint, then hint again. Initialization excluded. Native caches stay warm within each sequence. No opening lookup book. Diagnostic cases, not a random workload or playing-strength test. Local HTTP and desktop browser, no physical-phone or WAN claim. Median and range only for repeated samples.
